footprints.split_why: Resorts are drawn as one building holding podium and towers: a tower drawn across a casino (the Eiffel Tower over Paris) is cut out of it first and each piece keeps its own building's height, and where only building parts carry the towers (MGM Grand, New York-New York, Westgate) the footprint is cut into its parts and its podium

succession.dry_why: The Mojave: NLCD's barren land and shrub/scrub are desert pavement and creosote, which grow no green; developed open space (golf courses, the Strip's medians) is watered and stays grown

world.sea_source: No sea in the frame, and none within 350 km; heights are NAVD88 (GEOID18) as the survey gives them
